prompt: Our design system has 200+ tokens but developers keep creating new ones instead of reusing existing ones. How do I audit our codebase for design system compliance?

assertions.text: Scans codebase for hardcoded values that should use existing tokens
Identifies redundant or duplicate tokens in the token set
Checks component consistency against design system standards
Flags specific files where developers created new tokens instead of reusing
Produces an audit report with specific violations and remediation priorities
